request: Create a reusable OmicsClaw Skill proposal from successful Autonomous Run 7787182985b2435997433fa94a7b7096. The Skill performs deterministic fixed-period 24-hour single-component cosinor OLS for a bulk RNA time-course CSV with gene rows and T{hh}_R{rep} columns. Primary outputs: cosinor_results.csv, semantic_summary.json, report.md. Method: fixed-period-cosinor-ols. Trigger keywords: cosinor, circadian rhythmicity, 24-hour rhythm, bulk RNA time course.
summary: Deterministic fixed-period 24-hour single-component cosinor OLS rhythm analysis for a bulk RNA time-course CSV.
input_formats: CSV with gene rows and T{hh}_R{rep} columns
